template: group_normalize(multiply(group_zscore(divide(winsorize(ts_backfill({eps_best_eeps_cur_yr},63),std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill({ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr},63),std=4)), sector), add(1, multiply(0.3, quantile(group_rank(winsorize(ts_delta({eps_best_eeps_cur_yr},5),std=4), sector), driver=gaussian)))), sector)
idea: 分位非线性响应增强。将分析师修正信号通过group_rank映射为0-1分位后，利用quantile(driver=gaussian)将中间区间压缩、尾部拉伸，强化极端修正的区分度；对核心效率信号进行行业组内标准化后，通过group_normalize确保各行业多空平衡，控制行业暴露风险。
